A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.  
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8 (shot at ƒ11)

photos.alt: A photo of a view over the park terrace, with the forest visible on the left, and a view overlooking Paris on the right (only trees below are seen). There are two paths on the terrace, with grass in-between, and many many people walking under the clear sky. There is a child on a bicycle who stopped and looks over the scene, various groups of people walking together or alone with a dog, and there are many yellow flowers that can be seen on the green grass.
